properties.displayName: Deny downgrading Microsoft Defender for Cloud pricing tiers
properties.description: Protects Microsoft Defender for Cloud from being silently disabled by setting a plan's pricing tier to Free, the AWS-SCP equivalent of denying GuardDuty/Config tampering. A Free pricing tier is not itself a violation on a subscription where Defender was never enabled; this only blocks the WRITE that downgrades an existing Standard plan.

metadata.description: Start with Audit, move to Deny once the compliance report is clean.
